name: Kiryuu Usako
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c11686]Miina's[/url] second childhood friend. She accepts [url=http://vndb.org/c11693]Yuusaku[/url] as Miina's boyfriend more easily than [url=http://vndb.org/c11687]Myuu[/url]. Because her name "usako" can be a cute way to address rabbits and rabbits are weak she tries to use bears as a way to change her image.

[spoiler] When she moves in with Miina and Yuusaku she begins treating Yuusaku as an older brother and calls him Onii-chan for a short time. [/spoiler]
